classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design a protein sequence that exhibits ATP binding, NADPHX epimerase activity, metal ion binding, and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity. Mg(2+) is necessary. Return an output protein sequence.
assumptions: A validated local fallback is acceptable: retrieve and rank naturally occurring family sequences that best match the requested ATP-binding, NADPHX epimerase/dehydratase, metal-ion, and Mg2+-dependent activities, then return one representative output protein sequence rather than attempting unsupported de novo active-site invention from text alone.

Because no organism, length, localization, oligomeric state, or seed scaffold was provided, the plan will prioritize well-annotated homologs from the NAD(P)HX repair enzyme family and use literature-grounded GO retrieval to anchor sequence choice.

Mg(2+) dependence will be treated as a required mechanistic family constraint during literature grounding and candidate selection, even if not every retrieved database record explicitly encodes Mg2+ in the same annotation field.
Provider selected a local workflow template but returned runtime parameter values in workflow_plan.params; canonicalized to the validated template schema.
